title: Flip Thrift Finds on eBay
summary: Photograph an item and get an eBay draft with sold comps, a title and a price to review.

money_potential.label: Low

money_potential.note: Money tiers are our estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative earning potential, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: You list more items per hour.
Sold comps help you price to sell, not to sit.
who_its_for: Resellers, collectors and anyone clearing out a garage.
